subtopic: Investing in Small and Medium-Sized Companies
source_evidence: BDCs are a way for retail investors to invest money in small and medium-sized private companies
answer: A publicly traded business development company (BDC) is a type of closed-end investment fund that gives retail investors a way to invest in small and medium-sized businesses. BDCs invest in those companies’ debt and equity; some investments may also be in small public companies. The businesses are often early in their development or distressed, and a BDC may sometimes help manage a company it invests in. BDCs can be complex and have unique risks, so the source advises learning what companies a BDC invests in and what risks, debt, fees, and expenses it has before investing.
